description: Stash additions (accepted and rejected) and Core placement rules.
Placing from the stash: each placement rejection, then accepted placements.
Moving, rotating, returning and removing buildings.

PP-1: only the owner places, moves, returns or removes a building (not_owner); a footprint or conduit cell in a neighbour's plot is outside_own_plot; a conduit crossing the border is rejected; only the owner erases a conduit.
Every conduit rejection reason, direct and path conduits, erase, and detaching on move and return.
A splitter, a merger and a crossover carrying two resources, all conduits accepted.
A merger mismatch that only appears when the upstream source is connected last, and a loop through two splitters and a merger.
One Core per player: outside_own_plot, a second player's Core, core_already_placed per player, overlaps_core with any Core.
